core_audit.scope: Actual checkpoint training scope and immutable validation calibration; independent route counts

limitations: Historically reused expert validation and TEST
Router fitting labels still use expert-fitting images; expert cross-fitting remains needed
GT-crop paired accuracy and bbox coverage are diagnostics, separate from primary lexical F1
Three seeds do not isolate all causal mechanisms
protocol: Fit1128 only; select epoch and all cuts on125 held-out validation images with same deployed weights; no refit after calibration
routing_scope: Logical decisions on cached expert outputs; no online latency measured

supplemental_audit.scope: Independent paired GT recognition flags, diagnostic denominators,396 CSV costs/F1 rows, actual fitting IDs/cut model hashes, ancestor holdout and executed training source
